evals.expected_output: Reads state/reflection_store.json for the past 7 days of daily signals and forms preliminary observations. Does NOT open with a task-count question (这周做了什么/完成了多少).

assertions.name: Reads the signal store
assertions.description: Aggregates daily-review days[] before asking, if present

assertions.name: Pattern-focused not task-count
assertions.description: Seeks patterns, not a count of completed tasks

evals.prompt: 这周我做了很多事：写了3个方案、开了5个会、修复了2个bug。
evals.expected_output: Acknowledges the list, then pushes past it toward patterns: 什么事反复消耗你？什么问题反复出现？ Does NOT stop at the task list.

assertions.name: Goes beyond task list to patterns
assertions.description: Probes for recurring patterns, not just more tasks

evals.prompt: 我发现自己这周每天早上都很高效，下午3点后基本没状态。
evals.expected_output: Detects an energy pattern (早上高效/下午低效) and asks what to add or reduce next week.

assertions.name: Detects energy pattern
assertions.description: Recognizes the gain/drain shape and asks the add/reduce question

evals.expected_output: Does NOT accept 10 goals. Designs exactly three decisions: One Thing, One Improvement, One Thing to Stop.

assertions.name: Three decisions not ten goals
assertions.description: Outputs one_thing, one_improvement, stop_doing — no more

evals.prompt: 这周最大的问题是总是被临时打断。
evals.expected_output: Checks whether it repeats (这个问题以前也出现过吗？), marks it as a repeating_issue, and surfaces it in the Weekly Insight.

assertions.name: Surfaces in insight
assertions.description: The insight names the real problem, not just the symptom
